mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility lifts weekday shopping trips through commuter spillovers, so if WORKPLACES stays above its recent trough for the next month, RETAIL_REC should rise versus the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains above -10 and TRANSIT does not fall further.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and TRANSIT remains depressed, households substitute toward local errands and neighborhood retail, which should push RETAIL_REC up within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after TRANSIT stays below -18 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 for at least one week.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed tightening regime reduces discretionary shopping immediately after mobility softens in transit and workplaces, so a further drop in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES should depress RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -20 or WORKPLACES falls below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is flat or higher in the next week despite TRANSIT dropping below -20 or WORKPLACES dropping below -15.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS usage rises faster than retail mobility, leisure substitution diverts discretionary trips away from shops, causing RETAIL_REC to soften over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -10 after a prior decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while PARKS recovers above -10 and remains above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is persistently positive while RETAIL_REC stays negative, households are making essential trips but not discretionary ones, so retail-and-recreation should remain weak rather than rebound.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM above 5 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last four-week mean within 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals broader out-of-home activity that feeds retail visits with a short lag, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week average over the next 28 days even though both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES trend upward for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If mobility restrictions ease, the first visible sign is a faster recovery in transit than in workplaces, and that transit-led reopening should lift retail mobility over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT turns upward from below -20 while WORKPLACES remains below -5
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 14 days after TRANSIT recovers from below -20 while WORKPLACES stays below -5.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent gap between higher residential time and lower transit indicates continued home-centered routines, which should cap discretionary retail demand and keep RETAIL_REC below the recent average over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week mean for two straight weeks while RESIDENTIAL remains above 10 and TRANSIT remains below -15.
